GetSchedule.auth: Page session only. NOT replayable: a bare/page-context fetch returns 401 because OWA injects a per-request X-OWA-CANARY (httpOnly cookie, not JS-readable) + bearer; the MSAL token cache is encrypted (msal.cache.encryption cookie). Must let the page issue the request and intercept the response.
GetSchedule.response: [{ data: { getSchedule: { schedules: [ { scheduleId, availabilityView, error{message,responseCode}, scheduleItems[ { status, subject, location, isMeeting, isRecurring, startTime{dateTime,timeZone}, endTime{dateTime,timeZone} } ], workingHours, flexibleWorkingHours } ] } } }]
GetSchedule.availabilityView: String of per-slot digits; 0=free 1=tentative 2=busy 3=oof 4=workingElsewhere. NOTE: the captured response's window is in UTC (slot 0 = 00:00 UTC), so it cannot be decoded as local without the request's startTime/timeZone. The adapter uses scheduleItems for timing instead.
GetSchedule.scheduleItems_time: startTime/endTime dateTime are absolute UTC (timeZone.name='UTC'); convert to the user's local TZ for display. This is the adapter's timeline source.
GetSchedule.fires_when: Once per attendee when a mailbox is added to the Scheduling Assistant. Two GetSchedule variants fire: one with availabilityView+scheduleItems (free/busy), one with workingHours/flexibleWorkingHours and empty availabilityView.
GetSchedule.trigger_ui: OWA calendar deeplink compose -> Open Scheduling Assistant -> set Start date -> Add required attendee (room email) -> select resolved suggestion.

findmeetinglocations.auth: Same OWA session; bare page-context fetch => 401 (canary/bearer).
findmeetinglocations.response: Room suggestions with display name, email, capacity, building, and a coarse point-in-time Available/Unavailable badge (NOT a timeline). Backs the Scheduling Assistant 'Add a room' autocomplete.
findmeetinglocations.use: The adapter uses this (via the 'Add a room' field) to resolve a room NAME to its mailbox. It does NOT match a raw SMTP query, so email input is added via the 'Add required attendee' picker instead.
